delta: EffectGate exposes the currently executable capability set to ClayVerse reasoning.
A requested entityos.exec while no EntityOS bridge is admitted produces a persisted DENIED outcome instead of aborting the whole chat turn.
The denial is included in the assistant turn and causal episode with zero causal credit.
A digest-pinned EntityOS staged inside the one image may be verified at boot while CLAYVERSE_REQUIRE_ENTITYOS=0 without returning an executable bridge.
EntityOS execution becomes bindable only when CLAYVERSE_REQUIRE_ENTITYOS=1.

counterhypotheses.claim: Failing the whole request on unavailable EntityOS is safer than recording a denial.
counterhypotheses.reason: No effect is executed by the DENIED path; session/generation fencing remains before the decision and the denial becomes auditable causal state rather than leaving a partially persisted user turn.

counterhypotheses.claim: Embedding and digest-verifying EntityOS is equivalent to admitting execution.
counterhypotheses.reason: The current single-container directive requires isolated acceptance evidence before the internal substrate becomes an admitted action path; staged bytes and execution authority are now separate states.
